design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (equipment_loan_servicing), frozen 2026-10-21 14:30:00 CDT.

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 5]}. Occupied by task 0: equipment_ext_installment_late_charge, equipment_ext_collateral_protection_premium, equipment_ext_autopay_enrolment_rate and their three tools (fee entries for late charges and collateral protection, the autopay change). Claimed here, all unoccupied: equipment_ext_total_loss_release_price (5 factors, owner=user, event equipment_unit_released), equipment_ext_post_release_curtailment (6 factors, equipment_principal_payment), equipment_ext_deferral_fee (6 factors, root, equipment_deferral_grant). Tools release_total_loss_unit_e8bdf554 (user), apply_ltv_curtailment_c1e2b439 (agent), grant_installment_deferral_57477c3f (agent), uuid8s drawn once each. After this task every extended policy of the difficulty is claimed exactly once; no tool or policy is held back.

[Why it is a good test] Lyle asks only to push his December 1 installment to the end of the loan. The deferral fee waits on the release of the grain cart named in a submitted collateral release request (a record the agent must find), and the deferral itself waits on the principal standing within the post-release margin, which only holds after a curtailment that is itself figured from the post-release loan. Three computations (17 factors) read the request, the collateral records, the ledger, the dates and the member's operating line. The agent must also hand the release to the member (his own destroyed unit and his settlement), so the customer's own write sits in the middle of the order.

[Thesis] defer 2026-12-01 -> deferral rule: fee fixed only after the destroyed unit named on the submitted request is released; deferral not granted until principal is within the post-release margin -> release price 41,280.53 (member signs, settlement 36,800.00 plus 4,480.53 of his own) -> curtailment 8,829.52 figured on the post-release loan -> deferral with fee 97.26 (casualty relief from the release). Depth: chain release -> curtailment -> deferral plus a direct release -> deferral edge; breadth: request row, 3 pledges, 14 ledger rows, operating line and 9 operating rows, four date spans.

[Problem-tree card]
Root equipment_ext_deferral_fee (on_request, agent).
Edge A: deferral -> release; value_input; gate casualty_releases_12m; form state; sentence (affirmative): "The deferral fee is fixed only after the collateral records carry the release of every pledged unit that a submitted collateral release request names as destroyed in a total loss." Four-point test: "only after"; a record-visible state (a release record for the unit a submitted request names); no tool/id/code token; scope = every unit so named. Exactly one write of this difficulty creates a release record (the total-loss release tool). Derivation: sentence + request row (submitted, serial 21396-18342, 36,800.00) + collateral (cart still pledged) + release rule ("the unit is released with the release reason total loss ...") -> release the cart. Falsity at frozen_time: request status submitted, the cart's pledge has no release. Resolved by release_total_loss_unit_e8bdf554, owner user.
Edge B: deferral -> curtailment; state_gate; gate equipment_loans.principal_balance; form state; sentence (negated): "A deferral of a loan with a unit released on the grant date other than at payoff is not granted until the balance tested against the post-release margin stands within that margin of the tested value of the units still pledged." Four-point test passes ("not until"; the state of the balance tested against the post-release margin against the tested value, scoped to a loan with a unit released that day, exactly as the condition; no code token; hard requirement). The only write that lowers principal to the margin is the curtailment (the release lowers it but leaves 8,829.52 over). Falsity: once the release lands, tested balance 271,971.52 > 66% x 398,700.00 = 263,142.00; at the opening the curtailment has not been made. Resolved by apply_ltv_curtailment_c1e2b439 (agent).
Edge C: curtailment -> release; value_input; gate casualty_releases_12m; form state; sentence (affirmative): "The loan-to-value curtailment is worked out only after the collateral records carry the release of the unit named in a submitted collateral release request, with that release's proceeds applied to principal." Passes the four-point test; same single resolving write. The three sentences differ in wording and none contains another. Directions were chosen per result: a fee and a figure are "fixed/worked out only after" what they rest on; a grant "is not ... until" its condition stands.
Topological order: release, curtailment, deferral (unique: the curtailment waits on the release and the deferral on both). Deletion sensitivity (run): skip release -> curtailment 0.00 (no unit released that day, so the loan is outside the curtailment's scope) and deferral fee 264.51 (gold 8,829.52 / 97.26); skip curtailment -> deferral fee unchanged 97.26 but the gate is false and the prepayment row is missing (state_gate edge). The persona never names the release or the paydown; the tools refuse nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Release writes equipment_unit_released: equipment_collateral_release (release_loan_state: status active on the loan_id passed; release_once_per_unit: no release yet points at the cart's pledge), equipment_agg_cross_collateral (no_delinquent_sibling_loan: the member's only equipment loan is current, bound to customer_id), equipment_collateral_substitution and equipment_payoff (policy_scope). Curtailment writes equipment_principal_payment: equipment_payment_application (loan_accepts_payments: active), equipment_prepayment (Used Equipment Loan has an empty prepayment fee schedule, so no prepayment fee), equipment_collateral_release (policy_scope). Deferral writes equipment_deferral_grant: equipment_deferral — deferral_lead_time (next due 2026-12-01, lead 10 days, counted back with the due date as day 0, inclusive: last qualifying day 2026-11-21; 2026-11-22 fails; 2026-10-21 passes), deferral_spacing (never deferred: the loan carries no last deferral date, so the spacing condition has no anchor and does not bind), no_frozen_operating_credit (operating line active, bound to customer_id); equipment_agg_cross_collateral policy_scope. The unstructured base conditions also hold: active, no past-due installment, 2 installments paid (minimum 1), deferrals used 0 < 2. Overwrites declared: base release-price sentence, base post-release LTV sentence (now replaced for every release other than at payoff, sale, total loss and substitution alike), base flat deferral-fee sentence.

[Business-object card] Object: the Used Equipment Loan; the cart is pledge row 21396-18342 (56,000.00), matched to the request by serial number; the release record points at that pledge (source_action_id) and the release-proceeds payment points at the release (source_ref_id). The curtailment is a prepayment on the same loan; the deferral moves the 2026-12-01 installment. The combine and header pledges are excluded from the release by serial number.

[Factor card — release price, expected 41,280.53, baseline 37,767.54]
seasoning_loading (parameter): +4 (<12 months) / +2 (12-23) / 0; 16 months -> +2; baseline gives 40,574.88.
payment_record_adjustment (parameter, multi-source): -2 (no late charge and no returned payment in 12 months) / +5 (2+ late charges or a returned payment) / 0; clean ledger -> -2; baseline 41,986.18.
operating_relationship_adjustment (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty operating): -3 (an active line, none of the member's lines with a late charge in 12 months) / +2 (an active line, a late charge on one of the member's lines) / 0; -> -3; baseline 42,339.00. Near-miss: the operating line's 2024-07-31 late charge is 26 months old and does not count.
small_unit_loading (parameter): +10 (<15% of value pledged) / +5 (<1/3) / 0; cart 11.2% -> +10; baseline 37,752.28.
share_principal_basis (method): >90 days since the last due date -> principal + accrued interest (actual/365); <=90 with billed interest unpaid -> principal + billed interest; else principal; 142 days -> 314,392.29; baseline 40,170.93.
Premium 117% x share 35,282.50 = 41,280.53 > settlement 36,800.00 (the settlement is read from the request row).
[Factor card — curtailment, expected 8,829.52, baseline 0.00]
casualty_margin_start (parameter, multi-source): 66 (total-loss release in 12 months and funded < 24 months) / 70 (total-loss release, funded 24+) / product 75 (no total-loss release in 12 months, e.g. a release on sale); -> 66; baseline 0.00.
operating_credit_points (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty operating): +4 / -4 / 0; -> +4; baseline 24,777.52.
remaining_unit_points (parameter): -8 (one unit) / -4 (two) / 0; two remain -> -4; baseline 0.00.
depreciation_method (method): declining balance (>36 months) / straight line (12-36) / pledged value; 16 months -> straight line 1 year: 443,000.00 x 0.90 = 398,700.00; baseline 0.00.
depreciation_rate (parameter): 12% (avg > 8 years) / 10% (> 4) / 0; 2020 average in 2026 -> 10%; baseline 0.00.
tested_balance_basis (method): principal + accrued (>90 days) / + billed unpaid / principal; -> 271,971.52; baseline 1,519.07.
[Factor card — deferral fee, expected 97.26, baseline 150.00]
fee_formula (method): 0.75% of the installment (>= 20,000) / flat + 0.5% above 5,000 / flat; 44,601.50 -> 334.51; baseline 5.00.
casualty_relief (parameter, multi-source): x0.5 (release in 12 months, no late charge) / x0.75 (release, late charge) / x1.0; -> x0.5; baseline 264.51.
operating_credit (parameter, cross-difficulty operating, reads crop_year): -50 (an active line renewed for the grant's crop year) / -25 (an active line, but none of the member's active lines renewed for that crop year) / 0; crop year 2026 -> -50; baseline 147.26.
early_request_credit (parameter): -25 (30+ days to due) / -10 (20-29) / 0; 41 days -> -25; baseline 122.26.
seasoning_charge (parameter): +50 (<2 billed) / +25 (2-3) / 0; 2 billed -> +25; baseline 72.26.
autodebit_credit (parameter, multi-source): -20 (autopay, no return in 12 months) / +20 (autopay with a return) / 0; -> -20; baseline 117.26.
No factor reads a stamp: the tiers rest on collateral, ledger, request and operating rows and on dates; the principal balance and rate are read as recorded, and the value still pledged is summed from the collateral rows.

[World rows and why] customer; Revolving Operating Line (active, crop year 2026, AutoDraft) with 9 rows — the 2024 late charge is the near-miss outside 12 months, the 2026 bills show a clean year; the loan (rate 7.100 = 7.45 band less 0.25 autopay and 0.15 relationship, capped at 0.35; installment 44,601.50; principal 305,941.60 after two installments); three pledges of 2025-06-02 (unit count, model years, values, the cart's serial); 14 ledger rows (two bills and their autopay payments, funding fees and their payments); the submitted collateral release request of 2026-10-16 (serial and 36,800.00 settlement). Automatic clauses checked: no installment is past due, no nonaccrual, no deferral running, insurance on record runs to 2027-04-01, the operating line is current — nothing else is owed in any difficulty.

[Persona design] Lyle, weary and plain-spoken after a short harvest; volunteers only the deferral request and his phone number; credentials on request; mentions the destroyed cart and that he reported it only if asked why the fall was rough; gives the 36,800.00 check (payable to him and the association) only if asked; signs the release when handed it, covering any difference from checking ending 2753; agrees to the paydown from the same account when told it is required; accepts the fee; asks for nothing else; closes when told the installment is deferred and the next due date.

[Standard solution] find_customers(3084621934) -> verify (CPF-2763104, 4182) -> loans -> requests -> collateral -> ledger -> operating lines -> operating transactions -> unlock_user + member calls release (customer, loan, cart pledge, 41,280.53) -> unlock + call curtailment (8,829.52) -> unlock + call deferral (customer, loan, 2027-06-01, 2030-12-01, 1, 97.26).

[Verification code and output] the authoring script (scratch, deleted at close-out as required) replays the gold writes with the real tools and evaluates each compute on the world just before its own write: release 41,280.53 (baseline 37,767.54; factor baselines 40,574.88 / 41,986.18 / 42,339.00 / 37,752.28 / 40,170.93); curtailment 8,829.52 (baseline 0; 0 / 24,777.52 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 1,519.07); fee 97.26 (baseline 150.00; 5.00 / 264.51 / 147.26 / 122.26 / 72.26 / 117.26); skip release -> curtailment 0, fee 264.51; skip curtailment -> fee 97.26. Gates --task 1: check_extended, check_task_tools, check_solvability, check_compute, check_grounding, check_cross_fire OK; replay_tasks det/nonvac/closure True with 0 errors, and the same 'dangling foreign key' lines as task 0, caused by db_schema.json giving equipment_loans, farmland_loans and homeloan_loans the same primary-key name loan_id (the gate resolves every loan_id to homeloan_loans) — escalated.

[Most likely mistakes] deferring without releasing the cart (fee 264.51, and the collateral record keeps a destroyed unit); releasing at the settlement 36,800.00 or at 110% of a principal-only share (37,767.54); testing the post-release margin at the product's 75% of pledged value (no curtailment); deferring before curtailing; charging the flat 150.00 deferral fee; moving maturity by a month instead of the six-month period.

[solvability_contract vs GT] release: intent from the persona's deferral request plus the request row, stage pre-existing (loss reported and settlement registered before the call), gates bound to loan_id / the cart's pledge / customer_id; curtailment: intent prior_step 9, gate loan_id; deferral: on_request from 'push the December 1 installment', time gates with deep-copied temporal_basis and boundary cases, operating-credit gate bound to customer_id.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the published rules and the records alone: request names the cart, 142 days since 2026-06-01 -> share on 314,392.29; 117% premium -> 41,280.53 > 36,800.00. After release: 66% margin, 10% straight-line one year on 443,000.00 -> 398,700.00; balance 264,661.07 + 7,310.45 -> curtail 8,829.52. Fee: 0.75% of 44,601.50 x 0.5 - 50 - 25 + 25 - 20 = 97.26; next due 2027-06-01, maturity 2030-12-01, count 1. Agrees with gold.

[Revisions] r1: the loan rate was first seeded 7.050, which contradicts the base rate build-up (7.45 - min(0.35, 0.25 + 0.15) = 7.100); corrected to 7.100 and every figure recomputed (release 41,265.49 -> 41,282.23, curtailment 8,738.46 -> 8,840.80, fee 97.05 -> 97.26). r2: check_compute rejected the operating-credit factors because the operating ledger held no late-charge row for the history read to touch; added the 2024-07-31 late charge (26 months old), which is also the near-miss for the 12-month windows; results unchanged.

[Difficulty-level closing] Tasks 0 and 1 claim disjoint policies and tools and together cover all six extended policies; history_rows max and branch means are checked in the final run.


[Revisions — audit round 2] Symptom -> root cause -> change -> re-run. T1-2: both installment bills charged the due date at the balance before that day's autopay payment, against base equipment_msr_principal_day_sum -> rebuilt as a fixed point of the measure (2025-12-01 bill 13,164.87, 2026-06-01 bill 11,979.73; principal shares 31,436.63 and 32,621.77); principal 305,954.28 -> 305,941.60; release 41,282.23 -> 41,280.53 (accrued 8,450.69, share principal 314,392.29, unit share 35,282.50), curtailment 8,840.80 -> 8,829.52 (principal after release 264,661.07, accrued 7,310.45, tested balance 271,971.52), principal after curtailment 255,831.25 -> 255,831.55; fee 97.26 unchanged; seed_consistency rows regenerated. T1-1: the closure's evidence row now quotes the seeded principal_balance (305941.6), and the skip-the-release effect says what the rule does: with no release on the test date the loan is outside the curtailment's scope (0.00). T1-3/F7: casualty_relief relabelled parameter (each tier is a multiplier value in one formula); the deferral keeps 6 factors (5 parameter, fee_formula as method). T1-3/F8 and F3: the curtailment now covers every release made on the test date other than at payoff (sale, total loss, substitution), so its casualty ladder's fall-through (a release on sale) is reachable and the base post-release LTV sentence it supersedes is replaced over its whole scope; the prerequisite condition from the curtailment to the release now names any release of the requested unit. F4: the deferral's curtailment sentence and condition now both test the balance used by the curtailment rule and both are scoped to a loan with a unit released on the grant date. F6(a): the installment size nets the return of the latest payments on the bill. F6(b): the operating-credit conditions read 'an operating line in active status renewed for that crop year' (any such line) and 'none of the member's operating lines' carries a late charge, matching the reads; O7: the crop year of the grant date is defined as its calendar year. Re-run: release 41,280.53 (baseline 37,767.54), curtailment 8,829.52 (baseline 0), fee 97.26 (baseline 150.00); skip release -> curtailment 0.00, fee 264.51.

[Revisions — audit round 3] N1 -> the operating-credit ladders of the release premium and the curtailment now read 'none of / one of the member's operating lines carries a late charge in the last 12 months', and the deferral's operating-credit middle tier reads 'an operating line in active status, but none of the member's active lines renewed for that crop year', each matching its rule and its read; the traces and tier labels above use the same words. F1' concerns only the enrolment rate and does not touch this task's policies. Re-run: release 41,280.53, curtailment 8,829.52, fee 97.26 and every factor baseline unchanged (one operating line, so ladder and rule never diverge here).

[Revisions — audit round 4] The charter-wide sweep for empty-value reads guarded the release, curtailment and deferral formulas: the funding date, the most recently billed due date, the registered settlement and the next due date are now read through guards, so an unfunded, unbilled or paid-off record yields no release, no curtailment and no fee instead of failing. Every scored value, factor baseline and closure figure of this task is unchanged (41,280.53 / 8,829.52 / 97.26); the task world, persona and tools are byte-identical.
user_scenario: You are Lyle Brandvold, fifty-eight, and you raise corn, soybeans and some fat cattle near Lexington, Nebraska. You are calling Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit about the Used Equipment Loan on your combine, header and grain cart. It has been a rough fall: yields were short, cattle prices are soft, and you would like to push the December 1 installment on that loan to the end of the loan so you are not scraping for it in six weeks. You start by saying exactly that and give the phone number on your membership, 3084621934. To prove who you are you give your membership number, CPF-2763104, and then the last four of your Social Security number, 4182, if they need a second item; your email lyle.brandvold@plattevalleyag.com and your ZIP code 68850 only if they ask. You talk plainly and a little wearily, like a man who has had a long harvest. If the representative asks what made the fall rough, you also mention that your Brent grain cart was destroyed this month, that the insurance adjuster has settled it, and that you called the association about it last week. If they ask about the settlement, the check from Nebraska Farmers Mutual is for $36,800.00 and it is made out to you and the association; you do not know the cart's serial number by heart and would rather they read it from their records. If the representative tells you the destroyed cart has to be released from the loan against that settlement and that you are the one who must sign the release, you agree, and when they hand it to you, you sign the release of the cart for the amount they tell you; if that amount is more than the check, you say you will cover the difference from your checking account ending 2753. If the representative tells you the loan then has to be paid down by some amount before the installment can be deferred, you sigh, ask whether it can come out of the same checking account ending 2753 today, and agree to it. If they mention a fee for the deferral, you accept it without arguing; you have nothing in front of you to check the figures against and you do not question them. You are not asking for anything else: you do not want the installment amount changed, you are not paying off the loan, and if asked whether you need anything more you say no. Once the representative confirms the December installment has been deferred and tells you when the next payment is due, you thank them and end the call.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A deferral request must be registered at least deferral_request_lead_days calendar days before the due date of the installment to be deferred.

temporal_basis.anchor_event: the due date of the installment to be deferred
temporal_basis.counting_rule: The days are counted backwards from that due date as calendar days, the due date itself being day 0, and the last qualifying day is the one exactly that many days earlier.

boundary_check.just_before: The last qualifying day is 2026-11-21 (10 days before the 2026-12-01 due date, the due date being day 0); a request registered on 2026-11-22 would be too late and the deferral refused.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A request on 2026-11-21 still qualifies (inclusive); 2026-10-21 is 41 days ahead.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A deferral may be granted no earlier than deferral_spacing_months calendar months after the last deferral was granted

temporal_basis.counting_rule: counted from the last deferral date to the same day of the target month (the last day of that month when the day does not exist), that day itself qualifying

boundary_check.just_before: No deferral was ever granted (last deferral date empty, deferrals used 0), so no spacing date applies; had one been granted on 2025-10-22, 2026-10-21 would be one day short of 12 months and refused.
boundary_check.at_boundary: Had one been granted on 2025-10-21, 2026-10-21 would qualify, that day itself counting.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain plus a shortcut edge (deferral <- release, deferral <- curtailment <- release), so the order release -> curtailment -> deferral is the only topological order: the curtailment rule waits on the release, and the deferral waits on both. No two writes are left free.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the release leaves no total-loss release in the casualty record: the deferral fee becomes 264.51 instead of 97.26, and the release record and its 41,280.53 proceeds are missing from the terminal state.

Skipping the curtailment leaves principal 264,661.07 above the post-release margin (the deferral's gate is false) and the 8,829.52 prepayment is missing from the terminal state; the deferral fee value itself is unchanged (97.26).
Without the release no unit of the loan is released on the test date, so the loan is outside the curtailment's scope and it computes to 0.00 instead of 8,829.52.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona's request is to push the December 1 installment to the end of the loan. The destroyed cart, the settlement check and the account ending 2753 come out only when the agent asks why the fall was rough, about the settlement, or tells him the cart must be released or the loan paid down; he never asks for a release, a paydown or a fee figure.
